title: Validate JWT Claims
prompt: Write a validation checklist for a synthetic JWT integration covering signature, allowed algorithms, issuer, audience, expiry, and rotation.
objective: Apply JSON Web Tokens (JWT) through a safe, repeatable defensive review or test.

starter.template:
## Scope and assumptions
- Local/owned/authorized system:
- Asset and trust boundary:

## Expected secure behavior

## Test cases (include one denied/failure case)

## Evidence and result

## Root cause and remediation

## Regression test

expected_output: A unit-test matrix with valid and invalid claim scenarios; do not include live tokens or secrets.
acceptance_criteria: Uses synthetic data and remains inside an owned, local, or explicitly authorized test scope.
States the expected secure behavior and a relevant negative/failure case.
Includes sanitized, reproducible evidence and a root-cause-oriented remediation.
Adds a regression test or a concrete verification step.
Separates observations from confirmed findings and calls out the static grader’s limitations.
hints: Use a maintained library and pin trusted key/issuer configuration.
Keep credentials, session values, private data, and unrelated host details out of the submission.
The current static grader checks required terms only; a qualified human must review security correctness before the exercise is published.
grading_method: Static required-term smoke check only. This does not validate real system behavior, prove a vulnerability, or establish exploitability. Human review plus local/isolated tests are required before publication.
retry_policy: Allow retries. Completion and rewards remain governed by platform backend rules; this file defines no per-exercise reward override.
status_note: Draft practice item from the attached PDF Section C or a clearly labeled course extension; do not publish without human review of prompt, rubric, grading limitations, and fix correctness.
